Toolbox

Small interactive tools, right in your browser

Welcome to the toolbox — a collection of small, useful, client-side utilities. No accounts, no tracking, no data leaves your browser. All cryptographic operations use the browser's built-in Web Crypto API for security, so your secrets never leave your device. Just tools that do their job and get out of the way.

Key Generator

Random Key Generator

Click any key to copy. Press R to regenerate all.

100% client-side. All generation uses crypto.getRandomValues() — nothing leaves your browser.

Generating keys...

Why a Toolbox?

Not every useful thing needs to be a full project. These are the little utilities I keep reaching for — small enough to fit in a single page, useful enough to bookmark. Everything runs client-side with no data leaving your browser, because that's how tools should work. All cryptographic operations use your browser's built-in Web Crypto API so secrets never leave your device.

Want to Add a Tool? 🤝

All tools are open-source and live in the repo. PRs welcome!
